name: Post in a Room
description: Posts in one of the owner's collaboration rooms, w/collab/<room>, as the caller: the post records who made it from the request, never from the input. Anyone who may read the room may post. Mention one of the owner's agents as @Name to hand it the post as a task; its answer is posted back in the room. Mentions spend a small budget per thread, so mention only who must act. Returns the post with who it woke, who it queued behind a wake-up already under way, and who it did not wake: the thread's budget was spent, or the caller may not ask that agent.

room.description: The room: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, such as covia-release
